content: DRAFT If CanNmSynchronizedPncShutdownEnabled is set to TRUE , requests for synchronized PNC shutdown are pending and no transmission confirmation (indicated via CanNm_TxConfirmation ) of a previous call is pending, then the CanNm module shall request in the next main function call a transmission of a NM messa ge by calling CanIf_Transmit . In case the NM - PDU is not configured for triggered transmission in CanIf ( CanIfTxPduTriggerTransmit set to FALSE ), CanNm shall set for this message additionally the following data beneath the normal data:  Set the PNSR bit in t he CBV to 1  Overwrite the PN information in the user data (after NM User Data has been fetched, if CanNmComUserDataSupport is enabled ) by setting bits that corresponds to PNC IDs stored as pending request for a synchronized PNC shutdown to 1 and all other bits to 0.
